breaking_changes.what: routeStyles.js: label field renamed to labelKey
breaking_changes.migration_hint: Add useTranslation hook in Legend.jsx, use t(style.labelKey)
Use local helper _getTripMethodLabel(context, id) in each consuming widget

important_decisions: Background Workmanager isolate cannot use AppLocalizations — use static string maps with SharedPreferences language key instead
flutter_localizations uses ARB files, code-generated AppLocalizations class (not easy_localization)
Website i18n uses i18next-http-backend: translation JSON files loaded lazily from /locales/{lang}/translation.json
Default language: German (de) for both website and app
